mapper.select: SELECT w.id AS warehouseId, w.name AS warehouseName, 'DISTRICT' AS source, rule.priority FROM xsy_mall_district_warehouse rule JOIN xsy_warehouse w ON w.id = rule.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = FALSE AND w.status = 'ENABLED' WHERE rule.deleted = FALSE AND rule.district_code = #{districtCode} ORDER BY rule.priority, rule.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_mall_district_warehouse (district_code, warehouse_id, priority, deleted, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{districtCode}, #{warehouseId}, #{priority}, FALSE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{operator}, #{operator}) ON CONFLICT (district_code, warehouse_id) WHERE deleted = FALSE DO UPDATE SET priority = EXCLUDED.priority, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
